# stryker-js

> Introduce StrykerJS mutation testing or assess JavaScript/TypeScript test quality. Use Git diff mutations in CI and surviving mutants locally to find missing cases and weak assertions, including tests generated by AI.

## Install

### APM (recommended)

```bash
apm install mizchi/skills/stryker-js
```

Or declare it in `apm.yml` for a reproducible setup:

```yaml
dependencies:
  apm:
    - mizchi/skills/stryker-js
```

then run `apm install`.
